agent: leftovers wave, reader B (the side menus' frame, and the provinces, army and combat menus)
question: CSideMenu's slots and frame, CInGameIdler_OpenSideMenu and CloseSideMenus read whole, the six top-bar handlers and whether anything reaches them with the buttons absent, and CSideMenuProvinces, CSideMenuArmy, CSideMenuCombat with the unitbrowse_entry row (CUnitBrowserEntry) and CBrowserItem.

addresses.name: CSideMenu::CSideMenu
addresses.signature: CSideMenu* __stdcall CSideMenu::CSideMenu(CSideMenu* this, CInGameIdler* inGameScreen, Hoi3CString* windowName, void* mouseObserver)
addresses.comment: **The frame of every side menu** (interface/sidebar.gui). `this` on the stack, `ret 0x10`. Registers itself as the CReloadableInterface of the window's .gui file (the gui is the screen's slot 14; its slot 18 finds the window's type by name, whose +0x24 is the file name, copied to +4; then 0xA7E210), writes CSideMenu's vftable, keeps the screen at +0x20 and the mouse observer at +0x28 (all five menus the in-game screen makes pass null; only the deploy menu has one), and makes the window by name through the gui's slot 11 under the screen's slot 16 parent, kept at +0x24. Callers: CInGameIdler_BuildViews (the provinces, army and naval menus, built inline), CSideMenuCombat::CSideMenuCombat, the air menu's constructor and CSideMenuDeploy::CSideMenuDeploy. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x823E90-0x823F56: `mov esi,[ebp+8]` is this, `mov ebx,[ebp+0xC]` the screen, [ebp+0x10] the name, [ebp+0x14] stored at +0x28; `mov dword ptr [esi],0x15DFE3C` (CSideMenu's table per RTTI); `mov [esi+0x20],ebx`; the window from `call [edi+0x2C]` lands at +0x24; `ret 0x10`. The CReloadableInterface reading (+4 the file name, 0xA7E210) is the one CProvinceView's constructor record already gives for the same base table 0x15FDB48. Every caller pushes 0 for the observer except the deploy menu's. Wrong if the four stack slots are not (this, screen, name, observer) - each is read once at the offset given.

addresses.name: CSideMenu::Rebuild
addresses.comment: **Slot 0, the CReloadableInterface reload.** Notes whether the menu is shown (slot 4), hides it (slot 3), destroys the window (its slot 20), makes it again by the same name through the gui's slot 11, and shows it (slot 2) if it was shown, else hides it (slot 3). Answers true. Inherited by CSideMenuProvinces and CSideMenuCombat; CSideMenuArmy's slot 0 calls it and then rebuilds its list. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824070-0x8240F4: `call [eax+0x10]` (slot 4) saved to [ebp-1], `call [eax+0xC]` (slot 3), window `call [eax+0x50]`, the gui (screen slot 14) slot 11 with the window's name (+0x18 subobject slot 17), stored to +0x24, then slot 2 or slot 3 by the saved byte, `mov al,1; ret`. vtable.py --holding 0x824070: CSideMenu, CSideMenuCombat and CSideMenuProvinces slot 0, one family. Wrong if window slot 20 is not a destroy - the slot was not read, but CSideMenu's destructor calls the same slot on the same field.

addresses.name: CSideMenu::~CSideMenu
addresses.comment: Slot 1, the scalar deleting destructor: the body at 0x823F90 (the window's slot 20, the mouse observer deleted through its slot 0, the CReloadableInterface unregistered by 0xA7E2E0 and its file-name string freed), then free where the flag's bit 0 is set. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x823F60-0x823F7E (`call 0x823F90; test byte [ebp+8],1; ... call 0xB95F9B; ret 4`) and 0x823F90-0x824024. vtable.py --holding 0x823F60: CSideMenu slot 1 only. Wrong if 0xA7E2E0 is not the reload unregistration - it is paired with the 0xA7E210 of the constructor on the same +4 string.

addresses.name: CSideMenu::Show
addresses.comment: Slot 2: shows the window (+0x24, its +0x18 subobject's slot 13 - CFixedWindow::Show), a tail jump. Inherited by CSideMenuProvinces and CSideMenuCombat, which therefore show their icon and title and nothing else. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824100-0x82410C: `mov ecx,[ecx+0x24]; mov eax,[ecx+0x18]; mov edx,[eax+0x34]; add ecx,0x18; jmp edx`. The +0x18 slot 13 is Show in CTopBar::Show's and CCountryView::Show's records, and CSideMenuDeploy::Show opens with the same three instructions. vtable.py --holding: CSideMenu, CSideMenuCombat, CSideMenuProvinces slot 2.

addresses.name: CSideMenu::Hide
addresses.comment: Slot 3: hides the window (+0x24, its +0x18 subobject's slot 14), a tail jump. Every side menu but the deploy menu keeps it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824110-0x82411C: the same shape as slot 2 with `[eax+0x38]`. vtable.py --holding 0x824110: slot 3 of CSideMenu, CSideMenuAir, CSideMenuArmy, CSideMenuCombat, CSideMenuNaval and CSideMenuProvinces - one family, six tables.

addresses.name: CSideMenu::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 7, run every frame for a shown menu by CInGameIdler_UpdateOpenView: where the menu has a mouse observer (+0x28), tail-jumps into its slot 1; otherwise nothing. So the observer is polled each frame by the menu rather than registered with the map. CSideMenuProvinces and CSideMenuCombat keep it and have no observer, so their frame does nothing. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824030-0x824040: `cmp dword ptr [ecx+0x28],0; je ret; mov ecx,[ecx+0x28]; mov eax,[ecx]; mov edx,[eax+4]; jmp edx`. vtable.py --holding: CSideMenu, CSideMenuCombat, CSideMenuProvinces slot 7. CInGameIdler_UpdateOpenView's record has the per-frame slot 7 call on each shown menu.

addresses.name: CSideMenuArmy::Update
addresses.comment: **Slot 7, every frame while shown.** The mouse observer's slot 1 where there is one (there is not). Then `unit_queue` (window slot 31): where its number of rows differs from CSideMenuArmy::CountUnitRows(the player's country's units, CCountry +0xBAC, depth 0) the list is made again (CSideMenuArmy_BuildList); otherwise each row's slot 8 (CUnitBrowserEntry::Update) is called in list order. So a row is made again only when the count changes - an expand, a unit made or lost; a unit that moves keeps the location its row was made with. The player is the screen's slot 23. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.3.

addresses.name: CSideMenuArmy::AddUnitRows
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CSideMenuArmy::AddUnitRows(CSideMenuArmy* this, void* listBox, CUnitList* units, int depth)
addresses.comment: **What the army menu lists, and in what order.** Walks `units` in list order; at depth 0 a unit is taken only where it has no superior (higher_oob_unit_ptr +0x1E0 null) **and** is a land unit (slot 15); below that every unit with a superior is taken (so a fleet or an air group attached under a land headquarters is listed), and one without only if it is land. Each taken unit gets a CUnitBrowserEntry (0x100 bytes; the screen, this menu, the unit, depth), added to the list (its slot 4, with 1), and **where its outliner_expanded (+0xB4) is set its children (+0x1E4) follow at once at depth + 1** - a depth-first tree, each row under its parent. The expanded flag is the outliner's own, so a unit opened in one is open in the other. Recursive; `ret 0xC`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x825E60-0x825FBA: `cmp [ebp+0x10],ebx; jne` then `cmp [edi+0x1E0],ebx; jne skip`; `cmp [edi+0x1E0],ebx; jne take`, else `call [edx+0x3C]` (slot 15) `je skip`; `push 0x100; call operator new`; the screen from g_CCurrentGameState +0xBE8 (the lazily made 0xDA8 singleton at 0x1A89790); `push depth; push unit; push menu; push screen; push entry; call 0x8252D0`; the list's `[edx+0x10]` with `push 1`; `cmp byte [edi+0xB4],bl` then `inc depth; add edi,0x1E4; call 0x825E60`. CUnit +0xB4 is recorded as outliner_expanded, read by CArmyMember. Wrong if slot 15 is not 'is land' - CUnit_MaySplit's record reads it so.

addresses.name: CSideMenuArmy::CountUnitRows
addresses.signature: int __thiscall CSideMenuArmy::CountUnitRows(CSideMenuArmy* this, CUnitList* units, int depth)
addresses.comment: How many rows CSideMenuArmy::AddUnitRows would make: the same walk and the same two tests, counting instead of building, children of an expanded unit added recursively. `ret 8`. CSideMenuArmy::Update compares it with the list's row count each frame. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x825DF0-0x825E5B: the tests at 0x825E05-0x825E2D mirror 0x825E9D-0x825EC1 exactly; `inc ebx` per unit; `cmp byte [esi+0xB4],0` then `add esi,0x1E4; call 0x825DF0; add ebx,eax`; `mov eax,ebx; ret 8`.

addresses.name: _A0xf32dc95c::CUnitBrowserEntry::CUnitBrowserEntry
addresses.signature: _A0xf32dc95c::CUnitBrowserEntry* __stdcall _A0xf32dc95c::CUnitBrowserEntry::CUnitBrowserEntry(_A0xf32dc95c::CUnitBrowserEntry* this, CInGameIdler* inGameScreen, CSideMenu* menu, CUnit* unit, int depth)
addresses.comment: **One row of the army menu**, on a `unitbrowse_entry` window (interface/sidebar.gui), 0x100 bytes. `this` on the stack, `ret 0x14`. Keeps the window +0x20, the unit by id (+0xC8 pointer, +0xCC/+0xD0 the id pair, through the object-reference builder 0x42DD70), +0xF0 the screen, +0xF4 depth, +0xF8 the menu. `expand` gets the glue at +0x28 (CUnitBrowserEntry::OnExpandClicked); `select_frame` the glue at +0x78, whose handler 0x67A310 is the shared `jmp [vftable+0x10]`, i.e. the row's slot 4 (OnSelect). `name` = the unit's name (its slot 7); `location` = the name of the province it is in (+0x130, its +8 subobject's slot 7); `counter_type` = the sprite `GFX_counter_` + the key of the first brigade's type where intel_level (+0x1F8) is 3 or more and it has a brigade - else the empty static, and the icon is changed only where the sprite exists (otherwise the file's GFX_temp_unit_icon stays); `counter_size` = frame by oob_level: theatre 6, army group 5, army 4, corps 3, division 2 with more than one brigade and 1 with one, fleet 2, air and anything else 1 - CUnit::GetCounterSize + 1 inline, as the deploy menu's line has it. Ends with its own slot 8. No group and no tooltip is set. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x8252D0-0x825797 and the jump table at 0x82579C (seven entries 0x82571A, 0x825721, 0x825728, 0x82572F, 0x825736, 0x825743, 0x825748 setting 5, 4, 3, 2, regiments_count>1, 1, 0 before `inc ebx`). Strings 'unitbrowse_entry', 'expand', 'select_frame', 'name', 'location', 'GFX_counter_', 'counter_type', 'counter_size'; `mov eax,0x825A60` before the first glue build (0x8260A0) at +0x28 and `mov ecx,0x67A310` before the second at +0x78; vftable 0x15E0100 at 0x8253A5. The counter-key condition matches the recorded counter rule (FINDINGS-counters.md) byte for byte. One caller, CSideMenuArmy::AddUnitRows. Wrong if 0x67A310 is not a thunk to slot 4 - it is `mov eax,[ecx]; jmp [eax+0x10]`.

addresses.comment: **Slot 4, `select_frame`'s click: the row's unit becomes the selection.** Finds the unit by its id; where it exists, the menu's screen gets ClearSelection (slot 46) and then Select(unit) (slot 38) - a plain single selection, the panel opening as for a click on the counter. Nothing where the unit is gone. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x825B20-0x825BEB: the id lookup twice, `mov esi,[esi+0xF8]` (the menu), its +0x20 screen `call [eax+0xB8]` then `push edi; call [eax+0x98]`. CInGameIdler slots 46 ClearSelection and 38 Select are recorded. vtable.py --holding: CUnitBrowserEntry slot 4 only.

addresses.name: _A0xf32dc95c::CUnitBrowserEntry::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 8, from the constructor and every frame from CSideMenuArmy::Update. Finds the unit by id (nothing if gone). `expand` is **disabled (button slot 47) where the unit has no children** (children_count +0x1EC == 0) and enabled (46) otherwise; its text stays the file's `>` whatever the state. Then the row's window is moved to x = depth x browser_offset.x (`browser_offset` is { x = 10 y = 0 }, so ten pixels a level), its y kept. Name, location and counter are not touched here. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.3.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_BuildViews
addresses.comment: **Deletes and makes again the in-game screen's country views and side menus.** Every view of +0xD00 and every side menu of +0xD10 is deleted (slot 1) and both vectors emptied; then the six views are made and pushed to +0xD00 (0x77D090 first, the diplomacy view), and the six side menus pushed to +0xD10 in this order - which is their number: **0 provinces** (0x2C bytes, `sidebar_provinces`, inline), **1 army** (`sidebar_army`, inline), **2 naval** (`sidebar_naval`, inline), **3 air** (0x824C20), **4 combat** (CSideMenuCombat::CSideMenuCombat), **5 deploy** (0x70 bytes, CSideMenuDeploy::CSideMenuDeploy). None is shown. It goes on to the unit list's `unitlist_start`/`unitlist_offset` and further, not read. Callers: CInGameIdler::Enter (0x65D6A7) and ConsoleCmd_ReloadInterface. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x659760-0x65A29E: the two delete loops over +0xD00/+0xD04 and +0xD10/+0xD14 (`call [eax+4]` with `push 1`); the six `call operator new` + constructor pairs into +0xD00 (0x77D090, 0x7FB1A0, 0x81A110, 0x6BADA0, 0x61EAE0, 0x46FA00); `lea edi,[...+0xD10]` and three inline vector pushes after the base constructor 0x823E90 on 'sidebar_provinces' (table 0x15CEF24), 'sidebar_army' (0x15E00D8), 'sidebar_naval' (0x15E0444), then 0x824C20, 0x643BA0 and 0x8277A0 each followed by std::vector_pushBackByAddress (0x86CC20). The order agrees with the six top-bar handlers' numbers (provinces 0, army 1, naval 2, air 3, combat 4, deploy 5) and the alert's 5. Callers by findRefs --callers: 0x43B6FB and 0x65D6A7 only, `ret 4`.

It remakes the side menus and opens none. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_OpenSideMenu
addresses.comment: **Opens side menu `index` of +0xD10, or closes it when it is the one open - one at a time.** Notes the last menu that says it is shown (slot 4). Where one is: every shown menu is hidden (slot 3) and `bg_main_menus` (+0x1914) hidden; if that last one was `index`, CInGameIdler_LayoutUnitPanels and nothing is opened - the toggle. Otherwise: the selection is cleared (ClearSelection, slot 46), side menu `index` is shown (its slot 2) and raised (its slot 5, the window's slot 11). The numbers are CInGameIdler_BuildViews' order: 0 provinces, 1 army, 2 naval, 3 air, 4 combat, 5 deploy. Seven callers: CInGameIdler::OnAlertClicked (5, `alert_deployable_units`) and the six CTopBar::OnView*Button handlers (0 to 5), **which no button reaches** - so in the shipped game only the deploy menu is ever opened here. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x6655C0-0x6656C0 whole: the first loop sets [ebp-4] = edi and bl = 1 for each shown menu; the second calls slot 3 on each shown; `mov ecx,[esi+0x1914]; call [edx+0x38]` (as CInGameIdler::OpenCountryView hides it); `cmp [ebp-4],edi; jne` else `call 0x663400; ret 4`; then `call [edx+0xB8]` on the screen, `[edx+8]` and `[edx+0x14]` on menus[index]; both exits `ret 4`, ESI never set. findRefs --callers: seven direct calls; findptr: no pointer to it anywhere in the image. Pushed numbers: 5 at 0x64AEB0; 0, 1, 3, 2, 4, 5 in the handlers at 0x6CF0D5, 0x6CF323, 0x6CF573, 0x6CF7C3, 0x6CFA23, 0x6CFC73.
addresses.revises: Was 'only its call was read', inferred, with no signature: now read whole - the toggle, one at a time, the selection cleared, the menu raised, every number named and the seven callers said.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_CloseSideMenus
addresses.comment: Hides every side menu of +0xD10 that says it is shown (slot 4, then slot 3), then 0x664160 (which places the +0x1360 window by the deploy menu's width, where that menu is shown), and where the single unit panel exists (+0x135C) moves it back to the left: its x the widths of the +0x1360 window's two parts where that is up, else its own, through 0x761EB0. Thirteen callers: CInGameIdler::OnAlertClicked first of all, CInGameIdler::OpenCountryView, CInGameIdler_HandleInput twice, CSideMenuDeploy's update when its list is empty, and others. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x665320-0x665403 whole: `mov esi,eax`, the loop over +0xD10/+0xD14 with `call [eax+0x10]` then `call [eax+0xC]`, `call 0x664160`, `cmp [esi+0x135C],0`, the +0x1360 window's +0xF4 and +0xD4/+0xD0 widths (slot 24), `call 0x761EB0`, bare `ret`. 0x664160 reads only `[+0xD10]+0x14`, menu 5. findRefs --callers: 13 direct calls.
addresses.revises: Was inferred and said 'tidies the selection panel': now read whole, with what the tidying is and a register signature in place of no_signature.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_AnySideMenuOpen
addresses.comment: True where any side menu of +0xD10 answers its slot 4 (IsShown). The twin of CInGameIdler_AnyCountryViewOpen, which it abuts with no padding (trap 2). Callers: CInGameIdler_LayoutUnitPanels, CInGameIdler_LayoutUnitRows, CInGameIdler_RefreshOpenSideMenus, CCreateHigherCommand::Execute and CCreateNewHQCommand::Execute. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x6652D0-0x66531F: the loop over +0xD10 with `call [eax+0x10]`, `mov al,1` / `xor al,al`, bare `ret`s, ESI read and never set. CInGameIdler_AnyCountryViewOpen's record already names it as the twin at this address without an entry of its own. findRefs --callers: 0x5E00E0, 0x5E135D, 0x66340D, 0x6636AD, 0x665413.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_RefreshOpenSideMenus
addresses.comment: Where any side menu is open, each shown one is hidden (slot 3), shown again (slot 2) and raised (slot 5) - for the army menu that makes its list again. Called by CCreateHigherCommand::Execute and CCreateNewHQCommand::Execute, after the order of battle has changed. It opens nothing that was not open. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x665410-0x66548D: `mov esi,eax; call 0x6652D0`, then per menu `[edx+0x10]`, `[edx+0xC]`, `[edx+8]`, `[edx+0x14]`; bare `ret`. findRefs --callers: 0x5E00EB (in CCreateHigherCommand::Execute, 0x1DF600) and 0x5E1368 (in CCreateNewHQCommand::Execute, 0x1E0BB0).

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_SetDeployMenuShown
addresses.comment: Shows (slot 2, then slot 5) or hides (slot 3) side menu 5, the deploy menu, by the flag; then CInGameIdler_LayoutUnitPanels and 0x664160, and on a hide with the single unit panel up it is moved back as CInGameIdler_CloseSideMenus does. Only index 5. One caller, 0x41EC66 (in 0x41E510), which passes 0. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x665490-0x6655B7: `mov bl,[ebp+8]`, `mov esi,eax`, `[esi+0xD10]` then `[eax+0x14]` with `[edx+8]`+`[edx+0x14]` or `[edx+0xC]`; `call 0x663400; call 0x664160`; `ret 4`. findRefs --callers: 0x41EC66 only, after `push 0`.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_LayoutUnitPanels
addresses.comment: Places the single unit panel: its x is **the army side menu's window width** (side menu 1, its window's slot 24) whenever any side menu is open (CInGameIdler_AnySideMenuOpen) - all six windows are 256 wide in the files, so in effect the open menu's - plus, where the +0x1360 window is up (+0xF4), the widths of its two parts; its y kept. Then with exactly one row that row's window is hidden, otherwise CInGameIdler_LayoutUnitRows(null). So a side menu stands at the left edge and the unit panel beside it. Callers: AddUnitRow, RemoveUnitRow, CInGameIdler_HandleInput, CInGameIdler_OpenSideMenu (closing), CInGameIdler_SetDeployMenuShown and 0x41E510. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-selection.md, section B.1, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x663400-0x66342D: `call 0x6652D0; je`, `mov eax,[esi+0xD10]; mov ecx,[eax+4]; mov ecx,[ecx+0x24]; call [edx+0x60]` - element 1 of the vector, not the open one. findRefs --callers 0x663400: 0x41EC37, 0x65324C, 0x663AD4 (AddUnitRow), 0x6642E3 (RemoveUnitRow), 0x6654D7, 0x66567F. The rest of the comment is the existing record's, unchanged; its strength stays inferred for the part not re-read.
addresses.revises: Said 'the open side menu's width' and named two callers: the width is side menu 1's (the army menu's) window whichever is open, and there are six callers.

addresses.name: CTopBar::OnViewProvincesButton
addresses.comment: **`button_viewprovinces`'s handler, which nothing calls.** CInGameIdler_OpenSideMenu(0, the provinces menu); then looks up the six button_view* buttons in the top bar's window (slot 13) and sets `button_viewprovinces`'s frame to 2 if it was 1, else 1 (a toggle), and the other five to frame 1. The glue holding it (CTopBar +0x168) is made by CTopBar::CTopBar and **never attached to a button by CTopBar::Build** - and the six buttons are commented out of every topbar.gui - so it is dead code. No lookup result is tested. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x6CF0B0-0x6CF2FE: `mov esi,[edi+0x24]; xor ebx,ebx; push ebx; call 0x6655C0`; the six names; `call [edx+0x4C]` then `dec eax; neg eax; sbb eax,eax; add eax,2` into `[edx+0x48]` for its own button and `push 1` for the others; bare `ret`. findptr over every section: 0x6CF0B0 appears once, at 0x6C97C5, the constructor's `mov [esi+0x170],0x6CF0B0`. The glue +0x168 is written only at 0x6C97B3 (constructor) and 0x6C9C0C (destructor) in the whole CTopBar range 0x6C9530-0x6D0130, while CTopBar::Build takes `lea` of all thirteen other glues (+0x34 ... +0x34C) - the positive control.

addresses.name: CTopBar::OnViewArmyButton
addresses.comment: `button_viewarmy`'s handler, never reached (glue CTopBar +0x194, never attached): CInGameIdler_OpenSideMenu(1, the army menu), its own button's frame toggled 1/2 and the other five set to 1. Ends `ret` at 0x6CF54F with the next handler on the following byte (trap 2). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x6CF300-0x6CF54F: `push 1; call 0x6655C0`, 'button_viewarmy' toggled, the rest `push 1`. One pointer to it in the image, the constructor's store to +0x19C (0x6C9805).

structs.name: CSideMenu
structs.comment: The frame of the six side menus of interface/sidebar.gui (CReloadableInterface at +0, 9 slots). Kept in CInGameIdler +0xD10 in the order 0 provinces, 1 army, 2 naval, 3 air, 4 combat, 5 deploy. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.1.
structs.evidence: RTTI: CSideMenu's table 0x15DFE3C (rva 0x11DFE3C), written by CSideMenu::CSideMenu at 0x823F0E. Size: the provinces, army and naval menus, which add no field, are `operator new(0x2C)` in CInGameIdler_BuildViews, and the highest offset the base uses is +0x28.

structs.name: CSideMenuArmy
structs.comment: The army side menu, `sidebar_army`: the player's land order of battle as a tree. No fields of its own. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.3.
structs.evidence: RTTI base CSideMenu at offset 0; table 0x15E00D8 written at 0x65A00A after `operator new(0x2C)`; none of its four functions touches an offset above +0x28.

structs.name: CSideMenuProvinces
structs.comment: The provinces side menu, `sidebar_provinces`: the frame and nothing else. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.4.
structs.evidence: RTTI base CSideMenu at offset 0; table 0x15CEF24 written at 0x659EBD after `operator new(0x2C)`.

structs.name: CSideMenuCombat
structs.comment: The combat side menu, `sidebar_combat`: the frame and nothing else. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.4.
structs.evidence: RTTI base CSideMenu at offset 0; table 0x15CEF4C written by CSideMenuCombat::CSideMenuCombat; `operator new(0x2C)` at 0x65A228.

structs.name: _A0xf32dc95c::CUnitBrowserEntry
structs.comment: A row of the army side menu, on `unitbrowse_entry` (interface/sidebar.gui). A CStandardlistboxItem (its second table at +0x1C). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.3.
structs.evidence: RTTI: base CStandardlistboxItem at offset 0, tables 0x15E0100 and 0x15E0134 (+0x1C), both written by the constructor at 0x8253A5/0x8253AB. Size: `push 0x100; call operator new` at 0x825EC7 in CSideMenuArmy::AddUnitRows, the only caller.

struct_fields.name: gui_file
struct_fields.comment: the .gui file the window's type was found in - the key its CReloadableInterface base is registered under (0xA7E210)
struct_fields.evidence: CSideMenu::CSideMenu copies the gui's slot 18 result +0x24 into this+4 (0x401BD0 at 0x823EEB) and passes (this+4, this) to 0xA7E210; the destructor unregisters with 0xA7E2E0 and frees it. CProvinceView's constructor record reads the same base the same way. Wrong if +0x24 of the found type is not its file name - taken from that record, not re-derived.

struct_fields.name: in_game_screen
struct_fields.comment: the screen it belongs to: its slot 14 the gui, slot 23 the player, slots 46 and 38 the selection
struct_fields.evidence: Stored from the constructor's second argument at 0x823F14; read as the screen by CSideMenu::Rebuild, CSideMenuArmy::Update and CUnitBrowserEntry::OnSelect. CSideMenuDeploy's record has the same field.

struct_fields.name: window
struct_fields.comment: the menu's window (`sidebar_*`); shown and hidden through its +0x18 subobject's slots 13 and 14, its +0x5B byte read by IsShown
struct_fields.evidence: Stored at 0x823F44 from the gui's slot 11; Show/Hide/IsShown/Rebuild all use it. CSideMenuDeploy's record has the same field.

struct_fields.name: mouse_observer
struct_fields.comment: a CSideMenuMouseObserver, polled each frame by slot 7 through its slot 1 and deleted with the menu; null for all but the deploy menu
struct_fields.evidence: Stored from the constructor's fourth argument at 0x823F0B; read by CSideMenu::Update (0x824030) and CSideMenuArmy::Update (0x825C85), deleted by the destructor (0x823FCB). Every BuildViews caller and CSideMenuCombat push 0 for it.

struct_fields.name: window
struct_fields.comment: the row's `unitbrowse_entry` window
struct_fields.evidence: Stored at 0x82536E from the gui's slot 11 on 'unitbrowse_entry'; every element is found through it; destroyed in the destructor (0x825864).

struct_fields.name: observer_expand
struct_fields.comment: the first dword of the button glue attached to `expand` (0x50 bytes), its handler CUnitBrowserEntry::OnExpandClicked
struct_fields.evidence: Built by 0x8260A0 with EAX = this+0x28 and the handler 0x825A60 (0x825398-0x8253B2); passed to expand's observable +0x48 slot 1 at 0x825447.

struct_fields.name: observer_select_frame
struct_fields.comment: the first dword of the button glue attached to `select_frame` (0x50 bytes), whose handler calls the row's slot 4 (OnSelect)
struct_fields.evidence: Built by 0x8260A0 with EAX = this+0x78 and the handler 0x67A310 (0x8253CC-0x8253D7); passed to select_frame's observable at 0x82549E.

struct_fields.name: unit
struct_fields.comment: the row's unit, looked up again by its id (+0xCC/+0xD0) before every use; null when it no longer exists
struct_fields.evidence: Built by 0x42DD70 (the object-reference builder CMoveCommand's record names) from the constructor's unit; written after each FindPersistentById in OnExpandClicked, OnSelect and Update (`mov [esi+0xC8],eax`).

struct_fields.name: unit_id_type
struct_fields.comment: the type half of the unit's id
struct_fields.evidence: Read with +0xD0 as the key pair of FindPersistentById, with the `cmp eax,0x1268` registry split, in OnExpandClicked, OnSelect and Update.

struct_fields.name: unit_id
struct_fields.comment: the other half
struct_fields.evidence: As +0xCC.

struct_fields.name: in_game_screen
struct_fields.comment: the screen: its gui (slot 14) gives browser_offset
struct_fields.evidence: Stored from the constructor's second argument at 0x82540D; read at 0x8259D8 for the gui and at 0x82565E for the sprite table.

struct_fields.name: depth
struct_fields.comment: how many levels below a top-level unit the row is; the window's x is depth x browser_offset.x
struct_fields.evidence: Stored from the fifth argument at 0x8253FF; multiplied with browser_offset's x at 0x825A2E.

struct_fields.name: menu
struct_fields.comment: the side menu the row is in; OnSelect reaches the screen through it
struct_fields.evidence: Stored from the third argument at 0x825413; read at 0x825BC4 and its +0x20 used as the screen.

struct_fields.name: observer_viewprovinces

struct_fields.evidence: Constructor 0x6C97B3-0x6C97C5 (vftable, owner +0x16C, handler +0x170 = 0x6CF0B0); written elsewhere only by the destructor at 0x6C9C0C; no `lea` of +0x168 in 0x6C9530-0x6D0130, where Build takes the address of all thirteen other glues.

struct_fields.name: side_menus
struct_fields.comment: Begin of the vector of side menus (end +0xD14), made by CInGameIdler_BuildViews in this order, which is each one's number: 0 provinces, 1 army, 2 naval, 3 air, 4 combat, 5 deploy. Index 5 is the only one read by number outside the open/close functions (the deploy menu's tooltip, input and layout); index 1's window gives the unit panel its x.
struct_fields.evidence: The six pushes in 0x659760; fieldchain --field 0xD10 lists every site, and outside BuildViews and the loops of OpenSideMenu/CloseSideMenus/AnySideMenuOpen/RefreshOpenSideMenus/UpdateOpenView only `+0x14` (index 5) and `+4` (index 1, LayoutUnitPanels and LayoutUnitRows) are read.
struct_fields.revises: comment only: adds the order of the six menus and which indices are read where

slots_noted: CSideMenu slot 5 (0x824050: where there is a window, its slot 11 - read as raise) is left unrecorded: the same body is CStratWarfareWindow's slot 6, a fold across two families (trap 4). Slots 6 (0x598DB0, `xor al,al; ret 4`, 192 tables) and 8 (0x776F20, the empty tooltip, 76 tables) are folded stubs, so no side menu but the deploy menu claims an element or has a tooltip. CSideMenuMouseObserver's slot 1 is 0xABF890, the 1691-slot empty stub; its slot 0 (0x823E60) is the destructor and is not recorded. CUnitBrowserEntry slot 0 (0x8257C0, destructor body 0x8257F0) and its +0x1C table's slot 0 (0x826120, `sub ecx,0x1C; jmp 0x8257C0`) are not recorded.
